focus: maintainability: section 14 references and the reading guide
findingsSummary: 2 P2: section 14 reports the resource map's 28 missing entries as 28 missing files when 22 are citation forms (R9-P2-001), and the reading guide names 2 of the 6 regrade outcomes, leaving 144 findings unnamed (R9-P2-002).

findingDetails.title: Section 14 reports the resource map's 28 "missing" entries as 28 missing files, and 22 of them are citation forms no file could satisfy
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the declared review target (research/research.md:745); cites the resource map it reports. No file outside the target modified.
findingDetails.case: A reader checking the research's citation integrity reads "28 missing on disk", concludes 28 references are broken, and either distrusts the document or re-resolves citations that were never broken.
findingDetails.claim: The 28 MISSING rows are 14 path-plus-line lists, 2 globs, 4 directory listings, 1 range and 1 annotated path; only 6 name a file that does not resolve, and none of the 6 is cited by research.md.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether "missing on disk" means the map marks them missing rather than that the files are absent, and whether any of the six absent paths is cited by research.md.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence faithfully repeats the map summary, and the map is reducer-owned.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the classification of all 28 rows was read from the map and the six absent paths were probed on disk.

findingDetails.title: The reading guide names two of the six regrade outcomes, leaving 144 findings with no stated home
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inside the declared review target (research/research.md:22); cites the regrade log vocabulary. No file outside the target modified.
findingDetails.case: A reader asks where the 112 out-of-scope findings went, finds the guide naming only wrong and not verified, and cannot tell whether they were dropped, folded into a row, or never graded.
findingDetails.claim: The guide names 2 of the 6 outcomes the regrade log defines; 112 out-of-scope and 32 duplicate findings are also absent from the document and unnamed.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the two named outcomes are the only exclusions, and whether the guide covers the two change outcomes elsewhere.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The guide names the two outcomes that mean the claim was false, which is a defensible editorial choice.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the outcome counts were read from every cell of the log and sum to the 332 the document reports.
